Hey team! 😊
I hope everyone's having a great day! I just wanted to share a few quick tips to keep the store looking sharp and tidy as we head into the week. This way, we can make sure all our displays stay neat, and it’ll be easier to spot when things get moved around by customers.

Here are some quick display tips:

- Face all items in the same direction – This will help create a clean, organized look and will make it much easier for us to spot if something's been moved around. (best to keep them facing forward unless there's not enough space)

- Stuff bags and accessories – For items like bags, lunch bags, or toiletry bags, make sure they're stuffed or arranged in a way that shows off their design. It’ll keep them looking neat and make it clear to customers what they’re looking at.

- Use height and layering – Adding height to displays or layering items can help make them more eye-catching and organized.

- Group similar items together – Group products by type, color, or theme to create a sense of order and to make it easier for customers to shop.

- Tidy up as you go – If you spot something out of place, take a moment to straighten it up. It keeps the store looking fresh throughout the week.

Thanks for everyone’s hard work! Let’s keep working together to make sure the store looks great and stays inviting for our customers. 💪

Morning guys! Some info from evacuation training: 
- Stage 1 alarm will say 'stand by for further instructions' It is recomended to mostly close the shop doors and get ready to evacuate if needed.  
- Stage 2 alarm will say 'Emergency, evacuate now.' At this stage please lock up the store and evacuate via the fire stairs opposite our shop. Then proceed to the evacuation point outside the front entrace of QVB near Town Hall station where the Queen's statue is. Sometimes the alarm will skip stage 1. 

Something to note - the building is old and constructed mostly from timber, so in case of a fire it will get very dangerous fast. It also means that the alarms er on the side of caution and most of the time it won't be a 'real' emergency. But IMO it is better to be safe!!
